methods.name: Spatial panel ML (spml): within (individual, time, two-way) and pooled lag, error and SARAR models; individual random effects with Baltagi, KKP or no spatial error
methods.reference: written out (splm not installed): Elhorst (2003), Baltagi, Song & Koh (2003), Kapoor, Kelejian & Prucha (2007), Millo & Piras (2012) likelihoods, optimize/optim with a Newton polish, SEs from the Richardson Jacobian of the analytic score (numDeriv 2016.8.1.1); plm::plm(model = 'within', effect = ...) 2.6.7 for the non-spatial within coefficients; nlme::lme(method = 'ML') for the non-spatial random-effects fit (validation/r/cases/spatial_splm.R)
quantities: nlme::lme random-effects coefficients, variances and logLik
methods.tolerance: n = 294. Parameters Tol::iterative(1e-8) and logLik 1e-10, because the Newton profile optimiser converges quadratically to the root of the analytic profile gradient (R's optimum is Newton-polished to |gradient| < 1e-9). SEs Tol::iterative(1e-6): central differences of the analytic score against R's Richardson Jacobian. The non-spatial within fits at validation/README.md (coef 1e-8, SE and statistics 1e-6).

methods.name: Spatial panel GM/2SLS (spgm): w2sls, b2sls, ec2sls and g2sls spatial-lag models, the within GM spatial-error model and the within GS2SLS
methods.reference: written out (splm not installed): Baltagi (1981) EC2SLS, Kapoor, Kelejian & Prucha (2007) within GM moments (the exact root of the cubic first-order condition, checked against optim), Kelejian & Prucha (1998) GS2SLS, 2SLS with instruments [X, WX, W^2X] (validation/r/cases/spatial_splm.R)
quantities: SE of every coefficient and of rho (2SLS)
methods.tolerance: Closed-form 2SLS and FGLS at validation/README.md: coef Tol::coef(n), SE Tol::se(n), Sargan and variances Tol::stat(n) (n = 294 observations, 49 entity means for b2sls); the GM lambda and sigma^2 at Tol::iterative(1e-10), because the root of the cubic first-order condition is found by Newton-bisection to tol = 1e-8, after which the error is of the order of the squared step. Step 3 of the GS2SLS uses the original instruments H (Kelejian & Prucha 1998); not compared with splm (not installed).
